mathematical_sources.location: papers/square-difference-free.tex and papers/square-difference-free.pdf at the submitted repository commit; Theorem 1.1 and the finite interval-moment criterion.
mathematical_sources.note: Accompanying self-contained exposition of this development, not an independent prior source or priority claim. The Lean proof uses the stopping-word argument described in the manuscript and PROOF.md. The manuscript was written by GPT-6-Astra, prompted and supervised by Eric Naslund; its opening author note was supplied verbatim by Eric Naslund. Contact naslund.math@gmail.com. Apache-2.0.

mathematical_sources.location: Unpublished September 2026 research notes, synthesized as METHODS.md and CAPACITY-IMPROVEMENT.md in the working repository https://github.com/enaslund/sarkozy-lower-bound at commit fe0b29937c56b77ba5dd46328db340936e8473ac. These source files and the external computation bundles are not included in this standalone package. PROOF.md supplies a self-contained mathematical account of the formalized implication; README.md gives context and scope.
mathematical_sources.note: The general implication is formalized with finite stopping words. Original missing certificates were not retained; reconstructed data are encoded in Lean and checked by the kernel. All nine components, including the complete 215 and 437 witnesses, are proved without finite-check assumptions. No source-author endorsement or bibliographic priority is claimed.
mathematical_sources.title: Ranked residues, intervals, and the integer construction

mathematical_sources.note: The ranked-block realization, square-base word lifting, and CRT combination follow this construction, using increasing ranks and reverse-rank representatives. The interval-moment criterion and stopping-word proof go beyond the cited lemmas. The paper's full numerical theorem is not formalized, and source-author endorsement is not asserted.
mathematical_sources.title: Square-Difference-Free Sets beyond the Three-Quarter Barrier
